q: How do I calculate dyeing emissions per kg of wool in a Bhadohi carpet unit?
title: Bhadohi wool dyeing: CO2 per kg
short: Add the fuel burned to heat the dye vats, from wood, coal, diesel or gas invoices converted to CO2, and the electricity for pumps and dryers at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25. Divide by kg of wool dyed in the same month. Wood is biogenic, so report its CO2 separately.
audience: Carpet and rug dyeing units in Bhadohi, Mirzapur and Varanasi

ul: Fuel invoices with quantity and type.
Dyeing register with kg of wool per batch.

p: CO2 from wood is reported outside the scopes as biogenic; methane and nitrous oxide from burning it still go in Scope 1.
Lids on vats, reusing hot water and insulating pipes cut fuel per kg without changing the dye recipe.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel and electricity invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record, so dyeing energy per kg of wool traces back to the documents behind it.

sources.label: CEA CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector
